name: Victoria Falls
summary: One of the world's largest waterfalls and Africa's most iconic natural attractions.
description: Known locally as Mosi-oa-Tunya (The Smoke That Thunders), Victoria Falls offers breathtaking scenery, rainforest walks, river cruises, wildlife, and adventure activities.
travelTips: Carry a waterproof jacket during high-water season.
Book activities in advance during peak season.
Bring small USD notes for park fees and local purchases.
